title: Water Department to Conduct Scheduled Maintenance on Water Main Valves
summary: The Syracuse Department of Water is conducting scheduled maintenance on water main valves across 17 locations citywide in the coming weeks. Residents and businesses in affected areas will receive advance notice via door hangers, with temporary water service disruptions expected. The work is part of the department's ongoing water distribution system upkeep.
